Wurmple

Bug

Hoenn · Generation 3

Wurmple is a Bug-type Worm Pokémon first found in Hoenn (Generation 3). It stands 0.3 m tall and weighs 3.6 kg. It evolves into Silcoon and Cascoon. Its highest base stat is HP (45), with a base stat total of 195.
